mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.user_id, r.status, r.scheduler_version, r.run_control_version, (r.tool_job_anchor_json IS NOT NULL AND r.tool_job_anchor_json <> '{}'::jsonb) AS active_anchor FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET snapshot_json = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(COALESCE(snapshot_json, '{}'::jsonb), 'data_analysis_observability') THEN COALESCE(CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('data_analysis_observability', snapshot_json -> 'data_analysis_observability') ELSE COALESCE(CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb) END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{runId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET status = 'CANCELED', snapshot_json = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(COALESCE(snapshot_json, '{}'::jsonb), 'data_analysis_observability') THEN COALESCE(CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('data_analysis_observability', snapshot_json -> 'data_analysis_observability') ELSE COALESCE(CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb) END, run_control_version = CASE WHEN scheduler_version IN ('DUAL_POOL_V1', 'DUAL_POOL_V2') THEN run_control_version + 1 ELSE run_control_version END, ttl_expires_at = #{ttlExpiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{runId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED') AND (tool_job_anchor_json IS NULL OR tool_job_anchor_json = '{}'::jsonb) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_async_tool_task t WHERE t.run_id = #{runId} AND t.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') )
UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND state IN ('WAITING', 'READY')

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_recovery_notification n SET state = 'CANCELED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g WHERE n.group_id = g.id AND g.run_id = #{runId} AND n.state = 'WAITING'

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_work_item SET state = 'CANCELED', lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND state NOT IN ('RESULT_COMMITTED', 'EXECUTION_FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'STALE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_event (run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json) SELECT #{runId}, COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1, 'CANCELED', CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event WHERE run_id = #{runId}
